translation.title: Urea Ointment
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for progressive keratoderma of the fingers (the dry type of housewife's eczema), keratoderma of the palms and soles, ichthyosis, senile xerosis (dry skin in older people), lichen pilaris and atopic skin.
translation.usage: Once to several times a day, wash the affected area, apply this medicine and rub it in thoroughly.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have acute eczema or an inflammatory skin disease, if you have kidney failure, or on mucous membranes such as the membranes of the eye. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have inflammation or cracked skin, or if your skin has become more sensitive to irritation. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it directly on ulcers, erosions (raw skin) or wounds. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it accidentally gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you use it together with corticoids, dithranol or 5-fluorouracil. Adverse reactions may occur - hypersensitivity symptoms, occasionally eczematization, cracking of the skin, papules, a prickling feeling, a burning sensation and scaling, and rarely swelling and dryness; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Pain, a feeling of heat, and occasionally flushing and itching can occur. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
